id.description: Persistent entity ID within the Dataset; use it for detail lookup.

state.description: Advertiser lifecycle state: Active, Inactive, or Archived.

created.description: Time the entity was created, with UTC offset.

modified.description: Time the entity was last modified, with UTC offset.

allowedLocations.description: Configured Location Keys and selected placements where the advertiser may promote. An empty list means no locations are allowed. These are stored settings, not a calculation of effective eligibility.

allowedPromotionsJson.description: JSON-encoded Relewise allowed-promotion specifications, including nested product filters. Parse this string as JSON and preserve SDK $type metadata. Serialized from the SDK allowedPromotions configuration; null means no promotion specifications are configured, so the advertiser cannot make promotions. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/retailmedia/advertisers.html for its purpose and https://docs.relewise.com/docs/filters/index.html for embedded filter structure.
